703	def start_span_no_context(
704	    name: str,
705	    span_type: str = SpanType.UNKNOWN,
706	    parent_span: LiveSpan | None = None,
707	    inputs: Any | None = None,
708	    attributes: dict[str, str] | None = None,
709	    tags: dict[str, str] | None = None,
710	    metadata: dict[str, str] | None = None,
711	    experiment_id: str | None = None,
712	    start_time_ns: int | None = None,
713	    log_level: SpanLogLevel | str | None = None,
714	    links: list[Link] | None = None,
715	    description: str | None = None,
716	) -> LiveSpan:
717	    """
718	    Start a span without attaching it to the global tracing context.
719	
720	    This is useful when you want to create a span without automatically linking
721	    with a parent span and instead manually manage the parent-child relationships.
722	
723	    The span started with this function must be ended manually using the
724	    `end()` method of the span object.
725	
726	    Args:
727	        name: The name of the span.
728	        span_type: The type of the span. Can be either a string or
729	            a :py:class:`SpanType <mlflow.entities.SpanType>` enum value
730	        parent_span: The parent span to link with. If None, the span will be treated as a root span.
731	        inputs: The input data for the span.
732	        attributes: A dictionary of attributes to set on the span.
733	        tags: A dictionary of tags to set on the trace.
734	        metadata: A dictionary of metadata to set on the trace.
735	        experiment_id: The experiment ID to associate with the trace. If not provided,
736	            the current active experiment will be used.
737	        start_time_ns: The start time of the span in nanoseconds. If not provided,
738	            the current time will be used.
739	        log_level: Optional severity level to attach to the span. Accepts a
740	            :py:class:`SpanLogLevel <mlflow.entities.SpanLogLevel>` or its name
741	            (e.g. ``"INFO"``, ``"DEBUG"``). If not provided, the span level is
742	            resolved from the span type at end time.
743	        links: A list of :py:class:`Link <mlflow.entities.Link>` objects to associate with
744	            the span.
745	        description: An optional human-readable description of the span.
746	
747	    Returns:
748	        A :py:class:`mlflow.entities.Span` that represents the created span.
749	
750	    Example:
751	        .. code-block:: python
752	            :test:
753	
754	            import mlflow
755	
756	            root_span = mlflow.start_span_no_context("my_trace")
757	
758	            # Create a child span
759	            child_span = mlflow.start_span_no_context(
760	                "child_span",
761	                # Manually specify the parent span
762	                parent_span=root_span,
763	            )
764	            # Do something...
765	            child_span.end()
766	
767	            root_span.end()
768	
769	    """
770	    # If tracing is disabled via context(enabled=False), return NoOpSpan
771	    config = _USER_TRACE_CONTEXT.get()
772	    if config is not None and config.enabled is False:
773	        return NoOpSpan()
774	
775	    # If parent span is no-op span, the child should also be no-op. Preserve the
776	    # parent OTel span when present so descendants keep inheriting the dropped
777	    # trace context instead of starting a fresh root trace.
778	    if parent_span and parent_span.trace_id == NO_OP_SPAN_TRACE_ID:
779	        return NoOpSpan(otel_span=parent_span._span)
780	
781	    try:
782	        # Create new trace and a root span
783	        # Once OTel span is created, SpanProcessor.on_start is invoked
784	        # TraceInfo is created and logged into backend store inside on_start method
785	        otel_span = provider.start_detached_span(
786	            name,
787	            parent=parent_span._span if parent_span else None,
788	            start_time_ns=start_time_ns,
789	            experiment_id=experiment_id,
790	        )
791	
792	        # If the span was dropped by the sampler, return a NoOpSpan that
793	        # preserves the OTel span's context so that safe_set_span_in_context
794	        # propagates the correct trace ID to child spans.
795	        if not otel_span.is_recording():
796	            return NoOpSpan(otel_span=otel_span)
797	
798	        if parent_span:
799	            trace_id = parent_span.trace_id
800	        else:
801	            trace_id = get_otel_attribute(otel_span, SpanAttributeKey.REQUEST_ID)
802	
803	        # SpanProcessor should have already registered the span in the in-memory trace manager
804	        trace_manager = InMemoryTraceManager.get_instance()
805	        mlflow_span = trace_manager.get_span_from_id(
806	            trace_id, encode_span_id(otel_span.context.span_id)
807	        )
808	        mlflow_span.set_span_type(span_type)
809	
810	        # # If the span is a no-op span i.e. tracing is disabled, do nothing
811	        if isinstance(mlflow_span, NoOpSpan):
812	            return mlflow_span
813	
814	        if inputs is not None:
815	            mlflow_span.set_inputs(inputs)
816	        mlflow_span.set_attributes(attributes or {})
817	        if description is not None:
818	            mlflow_span.set_attribute(SpanAttributeKey.DESCRIPTION, description)
819	        if log_level is not None:
820	            mlflow_span.set_log_level(log_level)
821	
822	        if tags := exclude_immutable_tags(tags or {}):
823	            # Update trace tags for trace in in-memory trace manager
824	            with trace_manager.get_trace(trace_id) as trace:
825	                trace.info.tags.update(tags)
826	
827	        if metadata:
828	            with trace_manager.get_trace(trace_id) as trace:
829	                trace.info.trace_metadata.update(metadata)
830	
831	    except Exception as e:
832	        _logger.warning(
833	            f"Failed to start span {name}: {e}. For full traceback, set logging level to debug.",
834	            exc_info=_logger.isEnabledFor(logging.DEBUG),
835	        )
836	        return NoOpSpan()
837	
838	    for link in links or []:
839	        try:
840	            mlflow_span.add_link(link)
841	        except MlflowException:
842	            _logger.warning("Skipping invalid link: %s", link)
843	
844	    return mlflow_span

850

862	def _resolve_uc_trace_id(trace_id: str) -> str:
863	    """
864	    Resolve a plain trace ID to its Unity Catalog V4 form using the active experiment.
865	
866	    If ``trace_id`` already carries a location (``trace:/<location>/<id>``) or the active
867	    experiment does not store its traces in Unity Catalog, ``trace_id`` is returned
868	    unchanged. Otherwise it is qualified with the experiment's UC location so it can be
869	    routed to the UC-backed endpoints.
870	    """
871	    from mlflow.tracking.fluent import _get_experiment_id
872	
873	    if _carries_trace_location(trace_id):

875	
876	    location = TracingClient()._resolve_uc_trace_location(_get_experiment_id())
877	    if location is None:
878	        return trace_id
879	
880	    return construct_trace_id_v4(location, trace_id)

884	def get_trace(trace_id: str, silent: bool = False, flush: bool = False) -> Trace | None:
885	    """
886	    Get a trace by the given request ID if it exists.
887	
888	    This function retrieves the trace from the in-memory buffer first, and if it doesn't exist,
889	    it fetches the trace from the tracking store. If the trace is not found in the tracking store,
890	    it returns None.
891	
892	    Args:
893	        trace_id: The ID of the trace.
894	        silent: If True, suppress the warning message when the trace is not found. The API will
895	            return None without any warning. Default to False.
896	        flush: If True and the trace is not found, flush any pending async trace writes and
897	            retry. Useful in tests or scripts where async logging may not have completed.
898	            Default to False.
899	
900	    .. code-block:: python
901	        :test:
902	
903	        import mlflow
904	
905	
906	        with mlflow.start_span(name="span") as span:
907	            span.set_attribute("key", "value")
908	
909	        trace = mlflow.get_trace(span.trace_id)
910	        print(trace)
911	
912	
913	    Returns:
914	        A :py:class:`mlflow.entities.Trace` objects with the given request ID.
915	    """
916	    # Special handling for evaluation request ID.
917	    trace_id = _EVAL_REQUEST_ID_TO_TRACE_ID.get(trace_id) or trace_id
918	
919	    # UC-backed trace storage only exists on Databricks. Branch early so the non-Databricks
920	    # path never enters the resolution logic below.
921	    is_databricks = is_databricks_uri(get_tracking_uri())
922	    if is_databricks:
923	        # A plain trace ID does not carry the Unity Catalog location needed to fetch traces
924	        # stored in UC. Resolve it from the active experiment's trace destination.
925	        trace_id = _resolve_uc_trace_id(trace_id)
926	
927	    exc: MlflowException | None = None
928	    try:
929	        return TracingClient().get_trace(trace_id)
930	    except MlflowException as e:
931	        exc = e
932	
933	    if flush:
934	        _flush_pending_async_trace_writes()
935	        exc = None
936	        try:
937	            return TracingClient().get_trace(trace_id)
938	        except MlflowException as e:
939	            exc = e
940	
941	    if not silent:
942	        hint = (
943	            " If using async trace logging, pass flush=True to wait for pending writes."
944	            if not flush
945	            else ""
946	        )
947	        # If the ID is still a plain ID, the active experiment did not resolve a Unity
948	        # Catalog location. Point the user to the fully-qualified form for UC traces.
949	        # Only relevant on Databricks, where UC-backed trace storage exists.
950	        if is_databricks and not _carries_trace_location(trace_id):
951	            hint += (
952	                " If this trace is stored in Unity Catalog, pass the fully-qualified trace ID "
953	                "in the form `trace:/<catalog>.<schema>.<table>/<trace_id>`, or set an active "
954	                "experiment linked to the UC location."
955	            )
956	        _logger.warning(
957	            f"Failed to get trace from the tracking store: {exc}.{hint} "
958	            "For full traceback, set logging level to debug.",
959	            exc_info=_logger.isEnabledFor(logging.DEBUG),
960	        )
961	    else:
962	        _logger.debug(f"Failed to get trace from the tracking store: {exc}.", exc_info=True)
963	    return None

966	def _flush_pending_async_trace_writes(terminate: bool = False) -> None:
967	    """Flush all pending async trace writes through the BSP and exporter queues.
968	
969	    Two-layer flush:
970	    1. flush_all_batch_processors() drains BSP-registered processors and their exporters.
971	    2. The direct exporter flush handles the no-BSP path (MLFLOW_USE_BATCH_SPAN_PROCESSOR=false),
972	       where the processor is not in the registry but the exporter still has an async queue.
973	
974	    Args:
975	        terminate: If True, shut down background threads after flushing. Used in test teardown
976	            to prevent thread leaks between tests.
977	    """
978	    # Lazy import to avoid circular dependency:
979	    # base_mlflow imports _set_last_active_trace_id from this module.
980	    from mlflow.tracing.processor.base_mlflow import flush_all_batch_processors
981	
982	    try:
983	        flush_all_batch_processors(terminate=terminate)
984	    except Exception:
985	        _logger.debug("Failed to flush batch processors.", exc_info=True)
986	    try:
987	        if trace_exporter := _get_trace_exporter():
988	            if hasattr(trace_exporter, "_async_queue"):
989	                trace_exporter._async_queue.flush(terminate=terminate)
990	    except Exception:
991	        _logger.debug("Failed to flush trace exporter async queue.", exc_info=True)

1245	def search_sessions(
1246	    max_results: int = 100,
1247	    run_id: str | None = None,
1248	    model_id: str | None = None,
1249	    include_spans: bool = True,
1250	    locations: list[str] | None = None,
1251	) -> list[Session]:
1252	    """
1253	    Return complete sessions that match the given search criteria.
1254	
1255	    A session is a collection of traces that share the same session ID, typically representing
1256	    a multi-turn conversation or a series of related interactions. This API retrieves complete
1257	    sessions by first identifying unique session IDs from traces, then fetching all traces
1258	    belonging to each session in parallel.
1259	
1260	    Args:
1261	        max_results: Maximum number of sessions to return. Default is 100.
1262	        run_id: A run id to scope the search. When a trace is created under an active run,
1263	            it will be associated with the run and you can filter on the run id to retrieve
1264	            traces.
1265	        model_id: If specified, search traces associated with the given model ID.
1266	        include_spans: If ``True``, include spans in the returned traces. Otherwise, only
1267	            the trace metadata is returned. Default is ``True``.
1268	        locations: A list of locations to search over. To search over experiments, provide
1269	            a list of experiment IDs. To search over UC tables on databricks, provide
1270	            a list of locations in the format
1271	            `<catalog_name>.<schema_name>[.<table_prefix>]`.
1272	            If not provided, the search will be performed across the current active experiment.
1273	
1274	    Returns:
1275	        A list of :py:class:`Session <mlflow.entities.Session>` objects, where each session
1276	        contains :py:class:`Trace <mlflow.entities.Trace>` objects that share the same
1277	        session ID. Sessions are ordered by the timestamp of their first trace (most recent first).
1278	        Each Session object provides convenient access via ``session.id`` and supports
1279	        iteration with ``for trace in session``.
1280	
1281	    .. code-block:: python
1282	        :caption: Basic usage - search sessions in an experiment
1283	
1284	        import mlflow
1285	
1286	        # Get all sessions from the current experiment
1287	        sessions = mlflow.search_sessions()
1288	
1289	        # Each session provides convenient access to ID and traces
1290	        for session in sessions:
1291	            print(f"Session {session.id} has {len(session)} traces")
1292	            for trace in session:
1293	                print(f"  Trace: {trace.info.trace_id}")
1294	
1295	    .. code-block:: python
1296	        :caption: Use sessions with evaluation
1297	
1298	        import mlflow
1299	
1300	        # Get sessions for evaluation
1301	        sessions = mlflow.search_sessions(
1302	            locations=["experiment_id"],
1303	            max_results=50,
1304	        )
1305	
1306	        # Flatten sessions for evaluation if needed
1307	        all_traces = [trace for session in sessions for trace in session]
1308	        mlflow.genai.evaluate(data=all_traces)
1309	    """
1310	    _validate_list_param("locations", locations, allow_none=True)
1311	
1312	    if not locations:
1313	        _logger.debug("Searching sessions in the current active experiment")
1314	    locations = _get_search_locations(locations)
1315	
1316	    session_id_key = TraceMetadataKey.TRACE_SESSION
1317	
1318	    # Step 1: Page through traces to collect unique session IDs (up to max_results)
1319	    seen_session_ids: set[str] = set()
1320	    session_ids: list[str] = []
1321	    page_token: str | None = None
1322	
1323	    while len(session_ids) < max_results:
1324	        traces: list[Trace] = TracingClient().search_traces(
1325	            max_results=SEARCH_TRACES_DEFAULT_MAX_RESULTS,
1326	            order_by=["timestamp DESC"],
1327	            page_token=page_token,
1328	            include_spans=False,
1329	            run_id=run_id,
1330	            model_id=model_id,
1331	            locations=locations,
1332	        )
1333	
1334	        for trace in traces:
1335	            session_id = trace.info.request_metadata.get(session_id_key)
1336	            if session_id and session_id not in seen_session_ids:
1337	                seen_session_ids.add(session_id)
1338	                session_ids.append(session_id)
1339	                if len(session_ids) >= max_results:
1340	                    break
1341	
1342	        page_token = traces.token if hasattr(traces, "token") else None
1343	        if not page_token:
1344	            break
1345	
1346	    if not session_ids:
1347	        return []
1348	
1349	    # Step 2: Fetch complete traces for each session in parallel
1350	    def fetch_session_traces(session_id: str) -> list[Trace]:
1351	        session_filter = f"metadata.`{session_id_key}` = '{session_id}'"
1352	
1353	        return search_traces(
1354	            filter_string=session_filter,
1355	            max_results=None,  # Get all traces in the session
1356	            order_by=["timestamp ASC"],  # Order by time within session
1357	            include_spans=include_spans,
1358	            run_id=run_id,
1359	            return_type="list",
1360	            model_id=model_id,
1361	            locations=locations,
1362	        )
1363	
1364	    max_workers = min(len(session_ids), MLFLOW_SEARCH_TRACES_MAX_THREADS.get())
1365	    with ThreadPoolExecutor(
1366	        max_workers=max_workers,
1367	        thread_name_prefix="search_sessions",
1368	    ) as executor:
1369	        session_results = list(map_with_context(executor, fetch_session_traces, session_ids))
1370	
1371	    # Filter out empty sessions, wrap in Session objects, and preserve order
1372	    sessions: list[Session] = [Session(s) for s in session_results if s]
1373	
1374	    return sessions

1936	def _merge_trace(
1937	    trace: Trace,
1938	    target_trace_id: str,
1939	    target_parent_span_id: str,
1940	):
1941	    """
1942	    Merge the given trace object under an existing trace in the in-memory trace registry.
1943	
1944	    Args:
1945	        trace: The trace object to be merged.
1946	        target_trace_id: The ID of the parent trace.
1947	        target_parent_span_id: The parent span ID, under which the child trace should be merged.
1948	    """
1949	    trace_manager = InMemoryTraceManager.get_instance()
1950	
1951	    # The merged trace should have the same trace ID as the parent trace.
1952	    with trace_manager.get_trace(target_trace_id) as parent_trace:
1953	        if not parent_trace:
1954	            _logger.warning(f"Parent trace with ID {target_trace_id} not found. Skipping merge.")

1956	
1957	        new_trace_id = parent_trace.span_dict[target_parent_span_id]._trace_id
1958	
1959	    for span in trace.data.spans:
1960	        parent_span_id = span.parent_id or target_parent_span_id
1961	
1962	        # NB: We clone span one by one in the order it was saved in the original trace. This

1970	                "its children."
1971	            )
1972	
1973	        cloned_span = LiveSpan.from_immutable_span(
1974	            span=span,

1976	            trace_id=target_trace_id,
1977	            otel_trace_id=new_trace_id,
1978	        )
1979	        trace_manager.register_span(cloned_span)
1980	        # end the cloned span to ensure it's processed by the exporter
1981	        cloned_span.end(end_time_ns=span.end_time_ns)

1983	    # Merge the tags and metadata from the child trace to the parent trace.
1984	    with trace_manager.get_trace(target_trace_id) as parent_trace:
1985	        # Order of merging is important to ensure the parent trace's metadata is

525	    @classmethod
526	    def from_otel_proto(
527	        cls,
528	        otel_proto_span: OTelProtoSpan,
529	        location_id: str | None = None,
530	        *,
531	        preserve_request_id: bool = False,
532	        resource: OTelProtoResource | None = None,
533	    ) -> "Span":
534	        """
535	        Create a Span from an OpenTelemetry protobuf span.
536	
537	        This is an internal method used for receiving spans via OTel protocol. By default,
538	        MLflow derives the canonical ``mlflow.traceRequestId`` from the OTLP trace ID so server
539	        ingest does not trust a client-sent request ID. Set ``preserve_request_id=True`` only for
540	        trusted internal round-trip flows, such as archived trace payload deserialization, where
541	        the stored MLflow request ID must be preserved exactly if present.
542	        """
543	        # Validate required fields - empty bytes indicate missing trace_id or span_id
544	        if not otel_proto_span.trace_id:
545	            raise ValueError("trace_id is required but was empty")
546	        if not otel_proto_span.span_id:
547	            raise ValueError("span_id is required but was empty")
548	
549	        trace_id = _otel_proto_bytes_to_id(otel_proto_span.trace_id)
550	        span_id = _otel_proto_bytes_to_id(otel_proto_span.span_id)
551	        parent_id = None
552	        if otel_proto_span.parent_span_id:
553	            parent_id = _otel_proto_bytes_to_id(otel_proto_span.parent_span_id)
554	
555	        # Convert OTel proto status code directly to OTel SDK status
556	        if otel_proto_span.status.code == OTelProtoStatus.STATUS_CODE_OK:
557	            status_code = OTelStatusCode.OK
558	        elif otel_proto_span.status.code == OTelProtoStatus.STATUS_CODE_ERROR:
559	            status_code = OTelStatusCode.ERROR
560	        else:
561	            status_code = OTelStatusCode.UNSET
562	
563	        serialized_attributes = {
564	            attr.key: dump_span_attribute_value(_decode_otel_proto_anyvalue(attr.value))
565	            for attr in otel_proto_span.attributes
566	        }
567	        mlflow_trace_id = (
568	            generate_trace_id_v4_from_otel_trace_id(trace_id, location_id)
569	            if location_id
570	            else generate_mlflow_trace_id_from_otel_trace_id(trace_id)
571	        )
572	        serialized_request_id = dump_span_attribute_value(mlflow_trace_id)
573	        if preserve_request_id:
574	            serialized_request_id = serialized_attributes.get(
575	                SpanAttributeKey.REQUEST_ID, serialized_request_id
576	            )
577	        request_id = json.loads(serialized_request_id)
578	
579	        # Convert proto Resource to OTel SDK Resource if provided.
580	        # We avoid _OTelResource.create() which has significant overhead from
581	        # environment variable reads (see https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/issues/15625).
582	        if resource is not None and resource.attributes:
583	            resource_attrs = {
584	                attr.key: _decode_otel_proto_anyvalue(attr.value) for attr in resource.attributes
585	            }
586	            otel_resource = _OTelResource(resource_attrs)
587	        else:
588	            otel_resource = _OTelResource.get_empty()
589	
590	        links = [Link.from_otel_proto(proto_link) for proto_link in otel_proto_span.links]
591	        for link in links:
592	            link.trace_id = _normalize_link_trace_id(link.trace_id, request_id)
593	
594	        otel_span = OTelReadableSpan(
595	            name=otel_proto_span.name,
596	            context=build_otel_context(trace_id, span_id),
597	            parent=build_otel_context(trace_id, parent_id) if parent_id else None,
598	            start_time=otel_proto_span.start_time_unix_nano,
599	            end_time=otel_proto_span.end_time_unix_nano,
600	            # we need to dump the attribute value to be consistent with span.set_attribute behavior
601	            attributes={
602	                **serialized_attributes,
603	                SpanAttributeKey.REQUEST_ID: serialized_request_id,
604	            },
605	            status=OTelStatus(status_code, otel_proto_span.status.message or None),
606	            events=[
607	                OTelEvent(
608	                    name=event.name,
609	                    timestamp=event.time_unix_nano,
610	                    attributes={
611	                        attr.key: _decode_otel_proto_anyvalue(attr.value)
612	                        for attr in event.attributes
613	                    },
614	                )
615	                for event in otel_proto_span.events
616	            ],
617	            resource=otel_resource,
618	        )
619	
620	        span = cls(otel_span)
621	        span._links = links
622	        return span

624	    def to_otel_proto(self) -> OTelProtoSpan:
625	        """
626	        Convert to OpenTelemetry protobuf span format for OTLP export.
627	        This is an internal method used by the REST store for logging spans.
628	
629	        Returns:
630	            An OpenTelemetry protobuf Span message.
631	        """
632	        otel_span = OTelProtoSpan()
633	        otel_span.trace_id = bytes.fromhex(self._trace_id)
634	        otel_span.span_id = bytes.fromhex(self.span_id)
635	
636	        otel_span.name = self.name
637	        otel_span.start_time_unix_nano = self.start_time_ns
638	        if self.end_time_ns:
639	            otel_span.end_time_unix_nano = self.end_time_ns
640	
641	        if self.parent_id:
642	            otel_span.parent_span_id = bytes.fromhex(self.parent_id)
643	
644	        otel_span.status.CopyFrom(self.status.to_otel_proto_status())
645	
646	        for key, value in self.attributes.items():
647	            attr = otel_span.attributes.add()
648	            attr.key = key
649	            _set_otel_proto_anyvalue(attr.value, value)
650	
651	        for event in self.events:
652	            otel_event = event.to_otel_proto()
653	            otel_span.events.append(otel_event)
654	
655	        # Convert links to OTLP proto format
656	        for link in self.links:
657	            proto_link = otel_span.links.add()
658	            # Convert MLflow trace ID (tr-xxx or trace:/loc/xxx) back to OTel bytes
659	            link_trace_id_hex = parse_trace_id_v4(link.trace_id)[1].removeprefix(
660	                TRACE_REQUEST_ID_PREFIX
661	            )
662	            proto_link.trace_id = decode_id(link_trace_id_hex).to_bytes(16, "big")
663	            proto_link.span_id = decode_id(link.span_id).to_bytes(8, "big")
664	
665	            # Add link attributes
666	            if link.attributes:
667	                for key, value in link.attributes.items():
668	                    attr = proto_link.attributes.add()
669	                    attr.key = key
670	                    _set_otel_proto_anyvalue(attr.value, value)
671	
672	        return otel_span

816	                converted = self._try_convert_data_uri(value)
817	                if converted is not None:
818	                    return converted
819	            if isinstance(value, dict):
820	                converted = self._try_convert_structured_content(value)

823	                    # in sibling keys (e.g. a data URI in another field)

827	                            for k, v in converted.items()

837	        from mlflow.environment_variables import MLFLOW_TRACE_MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE

839	        if not self._is_recording():
840	            _logger.debug("Skipping attachment storage because the span is no longer recording.")

844	        if max_size is not None and max_size > 0 and len(attachment.content_bytes) > max_size:

847	                f"Attachment too large ({size_bytes} bytes > {max_size} bytes limit). "
848	                f"Content discarded."

903	        if value.get("type") == "image" and isinstance(source := value.get("source"), dict):

906	                media_type = source.get("media_type", "image/png")
907	                if isinstance(data, str) and data:

1392	class LazySpan(Span):
1393	    """
1394	    A span that keeps its stored dict form and only builds an OTel-backed Span
1395	    when a property or conversion that needs one is accessed.
1396	
1397	    TRACKING_STORE rows already persist the span as JSON. Returning ``LazySpan``
1398	    from the store avoids an eager ``json.loads`` → ``Span.from_dict`` →
1399	    ``to_dict``/``to_otel_proto`` round-trip when the consumer only needs the
1400	    dict (for example ``get-trace-artifact`` or ``TraceData.to_dict``).
1401	
1402	    When ``raw_json`` is provided and load-time translation did not modify the
1403	    payload, artifact responses can emit that string directly and skip
1404	    ``json.dumps``.
1405	    """
1406	
1407	    def __init__(self, span_dict: dict[str, Any], *, raw_json: str | None = None):
1408	        # Skip Span.__init__: we intentionally avoid constructing an OTel span
1409	        # until a caller needs property access or OTLP conversion.
1410	        self.__dict__["_span_dict"] = span_dict
1411	        self.__dict__["_raw_json"] = raw_json
1412	        self.__dict__["_materialized"] = False
1413	
1414	    @classmethod
1415	    def from_stored_content(cls, content: str) -> "LazySpan":
1416	        """Build a ``LazySpan`` from a TRACKING_STORE ``spans.content`` value."""
1417	        # Deferred to avoid a circular import with mlflow.tracing.otel.translation.
1418	        from mlflow.tracing.otel.translation import translate_loaded_span_with_status
1419	
1420	        span_dict = json.loads(content)
1421	        modified = translate_loaded_span_with_status(span_dict)
1422	        return cls(span_dict, raw_json=None if modified else content)
1423	
1424	    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
1425	        # to_dict() returns the live mutable dict. Once a caller can mutate it,
1426	        # raw JSON passthrough is no longer safe for subsequent exports.
1427	        self.__dict__["_raw_json"] = None
1428	        return self.__dict__["_span_dict"]
1429	
1430	    def json_for_export(self) -> str:
1431	        """Return JSON text for artifact export without an unnecessary re-dump."""
1432	        raw_json = self.__dict__["_raw_json"]
1433	        if raw_json is not None:
1434	            return raw_json
1435	        return json.dumps(self.__dict__["_span_dict"], separators=(",", ":"))
1436	
1437	    def _ensure_materialized(self) -> None:
1438	        if self.__dict__["_materialized"]:
1439	            return
1440	        span = Span.from_dict(self.__dict__["_span_dict"])
1441	        self.__dict__["_span"] = span._span
1442	        self.__dict__["_attributes"] = span._attributes
1443	        self.__dict__["_attachments"] = span._attachments
1444	        self.__dict__["_links"] = span._links
1445	        self.__dict__["_materialized"] = True
1446	
1447	    def __getstate__(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
1448	        # Carry only one form of the data: the raw JSON when it is still in sync, else the dict.
1449	        raw_json = self.__dict__["_raw_json"]
1450	        if raw_json is not None:
1451	            state = {"raw_json": raw_json}
1452	        else:
1453	            state = {"span_dict": self.__dict__["_span_dict"]}
1454	        if attachments := self.__dict__.get("_attachments"):
1455	            state["attachments"] = dict(attachments)
1456	        return state
1457	
1458	    def __setstate__(self, state: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1459	        raw_json = state.get("raw_json")
1460	        span_dict = json.loads(raw_json) if raw_json is not None else state["span_dict"]
1461	        LazySpan.__init__(self, span_dict, raw_json=raw_json)
1462	        if attachments := state.get("attachments"):
1463	            self._ensure_materialized()
1464	            self.__dict__["_attachments"] = attachments
1465	
1466	    def __getattr__(self, name: str):
1467	        # Protocol lookups (e.g. `__deepcopy__`, `__getnewargs_ex__` probed by copy/pickle)
1468	        # must not materialize the span, and must not touch state that may not exist yet on
1469	        # an instance being reconstructed.
1470	        if name.startswith("__") and name.endswith("__"):
1471	            raise AttributeError(f"'{type(self).__name__}' object has no attribute '{name}'")
1472	        self._ensure_materialized()
1473	        try:
1474	            return object.__getattribute__(self, name)
1475	        except AttributeError:
1476	            return super().__getattr__(name)
1477	
1478	    def __repr__(self):
1479	        if self.__dict__.get("_materialized"):
1480	            return super().__repr__()

1482	        name = span_dict.get("name")

1484	        request_id = attributes.get(SpanAttributeKey.REQUEST_ID)
1485	        # request_id may still be JSON-encoded in persisted attributes.
1486	        if isinstance(request_id, str):

1489	            except (TypeError, ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):

1492	            f"LazySpan(name={name!r}, trace_id={request_id!r}, "
1493	            f"span_id={span_dict.get('span_id')!r}, "
1494	            f"parent_id={span_dict.get('parent_span_id')!r})"

1611	class _SpanAttributesRegistry:
1612	    """
1613	    A utility class to manage the span attributes.
1614	
1615	    In MLflow users can add arbitrary key-value pairs to the span attributes, however,
1616	    OpenTelemetry only allows a limited set of types to be stored in the attribute values.
1617	    Therefore, we serialize all values into JSON string before storing them in the span.
1618	    This class provides simple getter and setter methods to interact with the span attributes
1619	    without worrying about the serde process.
1620	    """
1621	
1622	    def __init__(self, otel_span: OTelSpan):
1623	        self._span = otel_span
1624	
1625	    def get_all(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
1626	        return {key: self.get(key) for key in self._span.attributes.keys()}
1627	
1628	    def get(self, key: str):
1629	        if serialized_value := self._span.attributes.get(key):
1630	            try:
1631	                return json.loads(serialized_value)
1632	            except Exception:
1633	                # If failed to deserialize (e.g., string value is directly set to OTel span),
1634	                # return the original value as is.
1635	                return serialized_value
1636	
1637	    def set(self, key: str, value: Any):
1638	        if not isinstance(key, str):
1639	            _logger.warning(f"Attribute key must be a string, but got {type(key)}. Skipping.")
1640	            return
1641	
1642	        # NB: OpenTelemetry attribute can store not only string but also a few primitives like
1643	        #   int, float, bool, and list of them. However, we serialize all into JSON string here
1644	        #   for the simplicity in deserialization process.
1645	        self._span.set_attribute(key, dump_span_attribute_value(value))

616	    Regression test: when the MLflow SDK (OtelSpanProcessor.on_start) runs before OTLP export,
617	    it JSON-encodes mlflow.traceRequestId into the live OTel span via LiveSpan.__init__.
618	    The OTLP proto then carries the already-encoded value (e.g. '"tr-abc"' with inner quotes).
619	    from_otel_proto() must not double-encode it — the server-computed ID must always win.
620	    """
621	    otel_proto = OTelProtoSpan()
622	    otel_proto.trace_id = bytes.fromhex("12345678901234567890123456789012")
623	    otel_proto.span_id = bytes.fromhex("1234567890123456")
624	    otel_proto.name = "langchain_span"
625	    otel_proto.start_time_unix_nano = 1000000000
626	    otel_proto.end_time_unix_nano = 2000000000
627	    otel_proto.status.code = OTelProtoStatus.STATUS_CODE_OK
628	
629	    # Simulate what OtelSpanProcessor.on_start + LiveSpan.__init__ produce:
630	    # _SpanAttributesRegistry.set() calls dump_span_attribute_value("tr-abc") = '"tr-abc"'
631	    # so the OTel span attribute stored in memory is the JSON-encoded string '"tr-abc"'.
632	    expected_trace_id = "tr-12345678901234567890123456789012"
633	    already_encoded_id = json.dumps(expected_trace_id)  # '"tr-12345678901234567890123456789012"'
634	
635	    attr = otel_proto.attributes.add()
636	    attr.key = "mlflow.traceRequestId"
637	    _set_otel_proto_anyvalue(attr.value, already_encoded_id)
638	
639	    mlflow_span = Span.from_otel_proto(otel_proto)
640	
641	    # Server-computed ID must win — must start with 'tr-', not with '"'
642	    assert mlflow_span.trace_id == expected_trace_id
643	    assert mlflow_span.trace_id.startswith("tr-")

673	def test_otel_roundtrip_conversion(sample_otel_span_for_conversion):
674	    # Start with OTel span -> MLflow span
675	    mlflow_span = Span(sample_otel_span_for_conversion)
676	
677	    # Convert to OTel proto
678	    otel_proto = mlflow_span.to_otel_proto()
679	
680	    # Convert back to MLflow span
681	    roundtrip_span = Span.from_otel_proto(otel_proto)
682	
683	    # Verify key fields are preserved
684	    assert roundtrip_span.name == mlflow_span.name
685	    assert roundtrip_span.span_id == mlflow_span.span_id
686	    assert roundtrip_span.parent_id == mlflow_span.parent_id
687	    assert roundtrip_span.start_time_ns == mlflow_span.start_time_ns
688	    assert roundtrip_span.end_time_ns == mlflow_span.end_time_ns
689	    assert roundtrip_span.status.status_code == mlflow_span.status.status_code
690	    assert roundtrip_span.status.description == mlflow_span.status.description
691	
692	    # Verify span attributes are preserved
693	    assert roundtrip_span.span_type == mlflow_span.span_type
694	    assert roundtrip_span.inputs == mlflow_span.inputs
695	    assert roundtrip_span.outputs == mlflow_span.outputs
696	
697	    # Verify ALL attributes are preserved by iterating through them
698	    # Get all attribute keys from both spans
699	    original_attributes = mlflow_span.attributes
700	    roundtrip_attributes = roundtrip_span.attributes
701	
702	    # Check we have the same number of attributes
703	    assert len(original_attributes) == len(roundtrip_attributes)
704	
705	    # Check each attribute is preserved correctly
706	    for attr_key in original_attributes:
707	        assert attr_key in roundtrip_attributes, f"Attribute {attr_key} missing after roundtrip"
708	        original_value = original_attributes[attr_key]
709	        roundtrip_value = roundtrip_attributes[attr_key]
710	        assert original_value == roundtrip_value, (
711	            f"Attribute {attr_key} changed: {original_value} != {roundtrip_value}"
712	        )
713	
714	    # Also explicitly verify specific important attributes
715	    # The original span has a custom_attr that should be preserved
716	    original_custom_attr = mlflow_span.get_attribute("custom_attr")
717	    roundtrip_custom_attr = roundtrip_span.get_attribute("custom_attr")
718	    assert original_custom_attr == roundtrip_custom_attr
719	    assert original_custom_attr == {"key": "value"}
720	
721	    # Verify the trace request ID is preserved
722	    assert roundtrip_span.request_id == mlflow_span.request_id
723	    assert roundtrip_span.request_id == "tr-12345678901234567890123456789012"
724	
725	    # Verify events
726	    assert len(roundtrip_span.events) == len(mlflow_span.events)
727	    for orig_event, rt_event in zip(mlflow_span.events, roundtrip_span.events):
728	        assert rt_event.name == orig_event.name
729	        assert rt_event.timestamp == orig_event.timestamp
730	        assert rt_event.attributes == orig_event.attributes
